# Targets

<!-- Generated by `magus describe graph -o markdown`. Do not edit by hand. -->

> Generated by `magus run generate:rw .`. Do not edit by hand.
> If the counts look stale, trust `magus query` over this file.

Default charms: rw (local runs write; CI strips them with `--no-default-charms`).

A **target** is a named unit of work (build, test, lint, ...) declared as an `export fun` in a project's magusfile. This is a routing index: every target with a one-line summary, plus the commands that expand any one of them. It is extracted statically from the magusfile source, so it stays in lockstep with how the project actually builds.

## Route by question

| To find out                | Run                            |
| -------------------------- | ------------------------------ |
| what exists / what relates | `magus query "<terms>"`        |
| is this file generated     | `magus describe file <path>`   |
| what a target runs         | `magus describe target <name>` |
| what my change affected    | `magus affected ci`            |
| a failing run's output     | `magus query output <ref>`     |

## Quick start

```sh
magus run <target>          # from inside the project directory
magus run <target> <path>   # from anywhere in the workspace
magus run <target>:<charm>  # change HOW it runs (e.g. lint:rw)
```

Unfamiliar with a term? See the [Glossary](https://eli.gladman.cc/magus/glossary/).

Need the detail this index leaves out? Run `magus describe target <name>` for a target's fully-evaluated dispatch plan (sources, outputs, spells, command, policy).

## Query first

This workspace has a knowledge graph (magus.knowledge/v1alpha1). Query it instead of grepping:

```sh
magus query "<terms>"       # kind=spell, project=pkg/foo, relation=uses, free text, kind!=op
magus explain <node>        # one node: its edges, provenance, blast radius
magus explain <a> --to <b>  # how two nodes connect
magus graph stats           # god nodes, orphans, doc coverage
magus graph export -o json  # the whole graph
```

## Project: magus

| Target                         | What it does                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| ------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `opencode-runtime-generate`    | Builds the OpenCode wasm runtime and its wasm_exec.js via go generate.                                                                                                                                                         |
| `go-build`                     | Places the development binary and its harnesses as one readiness operation.                                                                                                                                                    |
| `go-build-product`             | Compiles magus at bin/magus, the product path go-build declares.                                                                                                                                                               |
| `go-test`                      | go's go-test over the root module.                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `image-registries`             | Reports where image-build under the same charms pushes and, with `verify`, fails when a credential does not resolve.                                                                                                           |
| `image-scan`                   | Scans the image with trivy; the rw charm writes SARIF and gates on HIGH/CRITICAL.                                                                                                                                              |
| `security`                     | Runs govulncheck and gates on dependency license terms.                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `man-generate`                 | Renders the roff man pages into manpage/ and refreshes internal/commands/testdata/api.lock, both serialized from the internal/commands tree.                                                                                   |
| `go-api-generate`              | Renders every exported declaration of the public Go packages (the list lives in cmd/magus-utils/public_api.go) into internal/commands/testdata/api-go.lock, beside the CLI's api.lock.                                         |
| `pr-title`                     | Fails a pull request title that is not a conventional commit subject, or whose subject is not imperative or carries a selling word.                                                                                            |
| `pr-description`               | Fails a pull request whose title or description the guard's pull-request-text rule would deny.                                                                                                                                 |
| `pr-changelog`                 | Fails a breaking pull request, or one that changes a public-surface lock or page, without a changelog fragment under changes/unreleased/, and any malformed fragment.                                                          |
| `pr-commits`                   | Fails a pull request any of whose commits carries an attribution.                                                                                                                                                              |
| `pr-deliberate-break`          | Lists the deviation lines a pull request adds and the gate files it edits.                                                                                                                                                     |
| `git-hooks-remove`             | Deletes the shims once installed from hack/git-hooks, and no other hook.                                                                                                                                                       |
| `types-generate`               | Console and docs generate their own TypeScript boundary mirrors.                                                                                                                                                               |
| `buzz-generate`                | Regenerates the Go host bindings from std.Module declarations.                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `magusfile-api-generate`       | Regenerates the magusfile API lock through TestMagusAPILocked and the std method-name lock through TestStdAPILocked.                                                                                                           |
| `langservice-generate`         | The browser reads this snapshot without linking the host modules.                                                                                                                                                              |
| `job-generate`                 | Regenerates the published job schemas (internal/job/gen/*.schema.json) from the structs that decode a job declaration and a holder's result.                                                                                   |
| `spells-generate`              | Regenerates the Buzz value-type mirrors (internal/spell/gen/types) and the per-module host declarations (internal/spell/gen/decls).                                                                                            |
| `mocks-generate`               | Regenerates the testify mocks (mockery, driven by .mockery.yaml): into the interface's gen/<pkg>test when other packages import the mock (types' into internal/gen/typestest), beside it in mocks_test.go otherwise.           |
| `config-generate`              | Regenerates the CLI config-flag plumbing from internal/config/config.go.                                                                                                                                                       |
| `spell-publish`                | Publishes every spell the binary ships as an OCI artifact under GHCR_SPELLS, tagged with the release version, write-once: a spell whose repository already carries the tag is kept unless the run is mutable.                  |
| `spell-lock`                   | Owns magus.lock.                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `postflight`                   | Logs counts from the history metrics (hotspots, ownership, affinity, volatility).                                                                                                                                              |
| `generate`                     | Regenerates every *-generate sibling, then gates on drift (scoped to cwd).                                                                                                                                                     |
| `termcast-record`              | Re-records tapes/core-loop.capture from a real magus on a real pseudo-terminal.                                                                                                                                                |
| `termcast-showcase`            | Re-records tapes/showcase.capture from a real interactive session.                                                                                                                                                             |
| `termcast-generate`            | Renders tapes/core-loop.capture into the README's animated SVG.                                                                                                                                                                |
| `termshots-generate`           | Renders the still SVGs of magus's interactive terminal screens for the docs.                                                                                                                                                   |
| `release-build`                | Builds one release binary for one platform.                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `release-sign`                 | Signs dist/SHA256SUMS with the Ed25519 key in MAGUS_SIGNING_KEY, then verifies the written signature against the active release key this binary embeds, so a mis-set key fails here rather than in every client's self-update. |
| `release-publish`              | Publishes this tag's GitHub Release, write-once.                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `release-manifest`             | Cuts this tag's release manifest from its published release and hands it to main's signed index.                                                                                                                               |
| `release-index`                | Builds docs/gen/public/release/index.json from releases/*.yaml, signs it, regenerates what derives from the new manifest, and under cd publishes the change as a pull request.                                                 |
| `release`                      |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `watch`                        | Rebuilds on every debounced change until interrupted.                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `test`                         | Tests with race detection.                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `cli-test`                     | Tests of the magus CLI, without -race: its TestScripts re-exec the raced binary hundreds of times.                                                                                                                             |
| `coverage-render`              | Renders the three language coverage badges into gen/site/assets/.                                                                                                                                                              |
| `coverage-measure`             | Writes the profiles coverage_render merges, except the console's: the console imports this project, so run `magus run test console` beside it.                                                                                 |
| `buzz-test`                    | Runs the in-file `test "..." {}` blocks in this repo's Buzz modules through magus's embedded engine, and writes their merged line coverage.                                                                                    |
| `build`                        | Compiles one artifact: the host binary, or the container image under the `container` charm.                                                                                                                                    |
| `install-linter`               | Builds .magus/custom-gcl, the golangci-lint carrying this repo's own linters.                                                                                                                                                  |
| `conventions`                  | Holds the repository's non-Go files to conventions no off-the-shelf linter checks; each rule is hack/lint/<rule>.buzz, and hack/lint/run.buzz reports drift between their reads and this footprint.                            |
| `golangci-lint`                | golangci-lint over the root module through .magus/custom-gcl, built first; the stock binary the go spell would run cannot read .golangci.yml.                                                                                  |
| `lint`                         | Builds the linter first, then golangci-lint, go vet, markdownlint, shellcheck, and the actionlint cantrip.                                                                                                                     |
| `format`                       | Regenerates, then formats Go, tidies `go.mod` and formats Markdown.                                                                                                                                                            |
| `ci`                           | Runs the CI gates through their declared dependencies.                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `completion-test`              | Exercises the completion scripts magus ships, each inside the official image for its shell.                                                                                                                                    |
| `agent-bench-report`           | Turns a results tree into the benchmark report.                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `agent-bench-run`              | Runs a benchmark manifest (default pilot.manifest) with CLAUDE_BENCH_TOKEN read through the secret provider, so the launching shell never holds it.                                                                            |
| `agent-eval`                   | Runs the bench suite's agent eval, which skips in the ordinary test target because it spends tokens.                                                                                                                           |
| `retrieval-eval-test`          | Replays each eval set under testdata/retrieval through query, refs and explain and prints recall, MRR and nDCG per set; no score fails it.                                                                                     |
| `conventions-test`             | Runs the tests that read the whole tree as data.                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `agent-harness-test`           | Drives the installed Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and OpenCode headless against a wired workspace; see docs/guides/integrations/agents.md.                                                                                       |
| `deploy-generate`              | deploy-generate assembles gen/site: the exact tree the Pages deploy publishes, docs at the root and the console under /console/.                                                                                               |
| `toolchain-report`             | Reports installed toolchains; excluded from CI because it probes remote tags.                                                                                                                                                  |
| `serve`                        | Serves prebuilt docs and console under one local origin, laid out like the Pages deploy.                                                                                                                                       |
| `image-build`                  | Builds the image locally, or with `cd` pushes and signs it; `stable` and `unstable` pick the channel.                                                                                                                          |
| `termkit-bindings-generate`    |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `skills-generate`              | Reinstalls the agent skills from their embedded sources in internal/agent/skills.                                                                                                                                              |
| `index-generate`               | Renders MAGUS.md via `magus describe graph`.                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `symbol-digest-generate`       | Writes gen/symbol-index.json, the symbol index digest.                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `proofread-decisions-generate` | Writes hack/policy/gen/proofread-decisions.json, RULES and MINIMUMS alone: a stdin run has no files, and proofread refuses a PATHS glob that matches no argument.                                                              |
| `graph-generate`               | Exports the knowledge and target graphs the browser Graph Explorer loads; with cd it also publishes the knowledge graph.                                                                                                       |
| `advice-test`                  | Runs the PR advisors' `test "..." {}` blocks under a plain `magus buzz -t`, from each script's own directory so their bare `import "advice"` resolves.                                                                         |
| `conformance-base`             | Measures the change's base for the conformance ceiling rule, which only reads the measure.                                                                                                                                     |
| `harness-drift`                | Fails when a local host installation lacks what its wired harness spell renders, naming each file and the command that merges it.                                                                                              |
| `swegrade-build`               | Builds swegrade, the grader a SWE-bench trial's eval log is piped through, into benchmarks/agent/bin.                                                                                                                          |
| `compress-cgo-test`            | Runs internal/compress's tests under the cgo tags, which the ordinary test target cannot reach.                                                                                                                                |

## Project: libs/train

| Target           | What it does                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| ---------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `install`        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `lint`           |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `build`          |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `test`           | Tiny fixtures only: the teacher on GoMLX's pure-Go backend against a naive forward pass, finite-difference checks of every training gradient, and the commands' helpers.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `security`       | Fails on a vulnerable symbol this module calls.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `generate`       | Mines gen/: the sources (tracked files, the pinned downloads, the forced vocabulary, the diagrams), the holdout files and the training pairs, all read off the tracked tree and the knowledge graph.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `fetch`          | Downloads every input inputs.yaml pins, verifying each sha256.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `teacher`        | Embeds the vocabulary's token texts, then the training texts, each into resumable, content-addressed shards under the cache root's teacher/, and appends each run's totals to runs.jsonl.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `teacher-parity` | Encodes the 1,024-text parity sample with one teacher, checks every row against the reference vectors (cosine >= 0.999) and the tokens against the reference tokenizer, and reports texts/s.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `bench`          | Runs one teacher over the external harness's exported subsets under the cache root's bench/ and writes its TREC runs beside them, where TestExternalEval in libs/embed fuses and scores them into evals.jsonl.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `oov`            | Appends to libs/embed/evals.jsonl, for each pinned non-Go repo in inputs.yaml, the share of its source files' identifier tokens with no row in the shipped vocabulary.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `train`          | Distills and trains the table from finished teacher runs, with the flags `embed train -h` lists after --; manual, never part of ci.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `table`          | Pins the converted table in libs/embed/gen/table.digest by its sha256, the digest its OCI artifact's layer and tag carry, so the release publishes the artifact without reading the pin off a registry.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `ci`             | The anchor `magus affected ci` keys off.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `models`         | Downloads the inputs inputs.yaml pins into the cache root and verifies each sha256, through `embed fetch`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `fertility`      | Appends, per tokenizer, the tokens per byte of held-in hand-written Buzz, Go and TS (gen/sources.jsonl's train split) to runs.jsonl.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `pilot`          | Runs one 200-step mlx_lm.lora pilot on train-split Buzz and appends its tokens/s, peak memory and load average to runs.jsonl.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `gguf-bench`     | Runs llama-bench pp512 and tg128 over every pinned GGUF and appends each one's rates to runs.jsonl.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `split`          | Deals the provenance groups of the hand-written Buzz, Go and TypeScript at a commit: exact and near-duplicate files become links, so both land on one side, and groups are held out by sha256 order until each language has about 10% of its bytes.                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `eval-sets`      | Writes the FIM dev and test sets of each language, the Buzz pass@k tasks, and the commits after the cutoff, then pins each.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `fim`            | Writes the FIM training samples of every train-side file at the cutoff commit, leaving out the files whose text repeats an evaluation text.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `g-1`            | Recounts every G1 bullet of plan 2.3 from the datasets and fails when one does not hold.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `eval-complete`  | Serves each base GGUF with llama-server (the target forks it; magus serves no model), completes the FIM test sets of stage S1 and appends plan 6.1's precision, recall, AUPRC, identifier and check-pass rows with their intervals to evals.jsonl and a row per system to runs.jsonl.                                                                                                                                                            |
| `pass-at-k`      | Samples 20 bodies per held-out Buzz task from each base at temperature 0.8 and top-p 0.95, grades each with `magus buzz -t` in a scratch tree under a seatbelt profile with no network, and appends the unbiased pass@1, pass@5 and pass@10 rows to evals.jsonl.                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `latency`        | Replays FIM-Buzz dev spans in typing order against each base, with and without --spec-type ngram-simple, and appends p50, p95 and mean latency, cold and warm, single-line (stop at a newline, 24 tokens) and 64-token, to evals.jsonl.                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `format`         |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `vocab`          | Writes the training texts (gen/sources.jsonl's files at the commit that wrote it, its diagrams, and CoRNStack rows), decontaminated against the eval sets embed bench reads from the cache root's bench/ (testdata/retrieval has no queries.jsonl, so judged-queries is left out), and the forced tokens under the cache root's training/, then the vocabulary's token texts beside them and its counts to gen/vocab.jsonl, which convert reads. |
| `convert`        | Writes potion-code-16M-v2 over gen/vocab.jsonl as the cache root's potion-code-16M-v2.table.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
